web.title: Document Head Management | TanStack Router Docs
web.description:
# Document Head Management
## Managing the Document Head [#](https://tanstack.com/router/v1/docs/guide/document-head-management#managing-the-document-head)
### Start/Full-Stack Applications [#](https://tanstack.com/router/v1/docs/guide/document-head-management#start-full-stack-applications)
```
import { HeadContent } from '@tanstack/react-router'

export const Route = createRootRoute({
  component: () => (
    <html>
      <head>
        <HeadContent />
      </head>
      <body>
        <Outlet />
      </body>
    </html>
  ),
})
```

### Single-Page Applications [#](https://tanstack.com/router/v1/docs/guide/document-head-management#single-page-applications)
```
import { HeadContent } from '@tanstack/react-router'

const rootRoute = createRootRoute({
  component: () => (
    <>
      <HeadContent />
      <Outlet />
    </>
  ),
})
```

## Managing Body Scripts [#](https://tanstack.com/router/v1/docs/guide/document-head-management#managing-body-scripts)
### Example [#](https://tanstack.com/router/v1/docs/guide/document-head-management#example)
```
import { createRootRoute, Scripts } from '@tanstack/react-router'
export const Route = createFileRoute('/')({
  component: () => (
    <html>
      <head />
      <body>
        <Outlet />
        <Scripts />
      </body>
    </html>
  ),
})
```

## Inline Scripts with ScriptOnce [#](https://tanstack.com/router/v1/docs/guide/document-head-management#inline-scripts-with-scriptonce)
### Preventing Hydration Warnings [#](https://tanstack.com/router/v1/docs/guide/document-head-management#preventing-hydration-warnings)
```
export const Route = createRootRoute({
  component: () => (
    <html lang="en" suppressHydrationWarning>
      <head>
        <HeadContent />
      </head>
      <body>
        <ThemeProvider>
          <Outlet />
        </ThemeProvider>
        <Scripts />
      </body>
    </html>
  ),
})
```
